title: OpenHoops
summary: Find the basketball run before you leave the house.
detail: A live map of courts and gyms, with check-ins, court conditions and a planner for the next run. Built around a question I ask myself: is anyone actually playing there? Currently in Android internal testing.

title: Letters with Lola
summary: A word game that keeps family close, even from different places.
detail: A two-player, crossword-style word-tile game for my grandma and sister. Made for playing together from a phone, tablet or browser—not for another trip through an app store.

title: Studio Siomai
summary: A welcoming home for my sister’s piano studio.
detail: A piano-teaching website with a playable piano and a student/teacher portal demonstration. The sample portal explores lessons, practice and shared notes; it is a demo, not a connected payment or student-records service.

title: Solitaire Clemulie
summary: Klondike, made for my grandma. Good cards. No clutter.
detail: An installable, offline-first Klondike game named for my grandma. The focus is the part that matters when you play every day: comfortable controls, satisfying card movement and a familiar table.

title: ChamCare Dental
summary: A calmer, more human dental website concept.
detail: A complete interactive dental website mockup, shaped by the clinic’s storefront branding. Includes care pages, first-visit guidance, searchable questions and a sample appointment flow. Requests are demonstrations, not real bookings.

title: Grit Athletics
summary: A home on the web for my volleyball-coach friend.
detail: A volleyball coaching website for Grit Athletics, hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Built for my friend and handed over to his own repository, with a home for his coaching approach and training programmes. The portfolio links directly to his website.

title: blockApp
summary: A little more intention about how you spend your screen time.
detail: An Android app-blocking project built around a saved daily schedule. It explores dependable blocking and clear escape controls, with more ideas for intentional phone use still in development.

title: tvapp
summary: A TV player that starts with “what should I watch?”
detail: An IPTV-player project for Google TV and Android, built around a remote-friendly browsing experience. It works toward playing user-supplied playlists and programme guides; it does not supply TV channels or subscriptions.

title: ShowTally
summary: A useful little dashboard for a live selling session.
detail: A browser-extension prototype for Whatnot sellers: sales totals, estimated fees, buyer activity and CSV exports. Designed as an observational overlay rather than a tool that bids or posts on someone’s behalf.

title: North of the 6ix
summary: A bold home-court advantage for a basketball coach.
detail: A mobile-friendly website concept for North of the 6ix Athletics in Barrie. Programme cards and a black-and-gold visual direction put the coaching programme front and centre. The repository currently records the concept, not a public booking service.

title: Ratings Explorer
summary: A clearer way to compare the places around you.
detail: A working-title project exploring local category rankings in Barrie and Ottawa–Gatineau. The idea combines review volume and average rating in a useful browsing experience. Built with Astro; not a launched directory.

title: Lo-fi Lab
summary: Music made out of code, one synthesized note at a time.
detail: A collection of Node.js experiments in generating lo-fi music. The project includes an original composition, Harbor Lights, and instrument studies—a different kind of creative coding.

title: Household Money
summary: Make the what-ifs easier to see.
detail: A browser-based household budgeting and scenario-planning dashboard. It explores spending sustainability, shared bills and changes to a financial plan. A private tool, not a financial-advice service; no personal figures are published here.

title: Shoe Ratings
summary: A small experiment in comparing shoe ratings.
detail: An early, single-page rating-aggregation project. Part of the collection of small research and web experiments that started this portfolio.
